record.bible_text: Then Naomi<WH05281> her mother in law<WH02545> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto her, My daughter<WH01323>, shall I not seek<WH01245><WTH8762> rest<WH04494> for thee, that it may be well<WH03190><WTH8799> with thee?
